peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 10.9% above its local comparables; 104 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (23.2): 1.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 87 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 8). Context, not scored: resales in 62.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,838,000 ($2,189 psf, 839–871 sq ft; 5 resales, May 2025–Apr 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,838 psf (range $1,524–2,535); 19.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $295,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,580,000 ($2,150 psf, 1,194–1,216 sq ft; 6 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,095 psf (range $1,546–2,761); 2.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $66,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Farrer Park MRT about 180 m, Jalan Besar MRT about 670 m; closer than 586 of 662 similar developments (the same as 9). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 760 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 100 m), more than 513 of 662 similar developments (the same as 79); nearest hawker centre Berseh Food Centre about 420 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 870 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 580 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,170 m; Aurea, 39 new sales, about 1,280 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,400 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,420 m; Orchard Sophia, 13 new sales, about 1,530 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,530 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,640 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 263 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 125 new sales and 829 resales (954 purchases); new sales were 13.1% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 630 m; Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,180 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,540 m; The Serra Residences (launch, launched, about 4 homes), about 1,710 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 829 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 372 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 829 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 881 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.9%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
